answer: Work waits on the marble until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the lagoon of the next round. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, held in escrow until finality, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Reaching the zephyr of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
